name: Uel
title: One of those who sent away their foreign wives
summary: Uel was one of the descendants of Bani who lived during Ezra's time. He was among the Israelites who had taken foreign (non-Jewish) wives and committed to sending them away following Ezra's reforms to restore covenant faithfulness after the exile.

keyEvents.title: Listed among Bani's descendants
keyEvents.description: Uel is mentioned as one of the descendants of Bani who had taken foreign wives in violation of God's law.

keyEvents.title: Commitment to send away foreign wives
keyEvents.description: Uel was among the Israelites who committed to sending away their foreign wives as part of Ezra's reform movement to restore covenant purity.

keyEvents.title: Ezra's reforms against mixed marriages
keyEvents.description: Ezra discovered that many Israelites, including Uel, had married women from surrounding peoples, and he launched a major reform to correct this.

keyEvents.title: The people gathered in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: All the men of Judah and Benjamin were summoned to Jerusalem to address the matter of foreign wives, and Uel was among those who came.
